voice.text: [slowly] Ahh… a new soul wanders in from the dark. Come closer. The Wheel of Fate has been waiting for you.
[whispers] Shhh… the candles have noticed you. Spin the wheel, and let the spirits decide what you deserve.
[amused] Don't be shy. The wheel doesn't bite… it only grades on a curve.
[whispers] The spirits grow restless… spin, before they assign homework.
Round and round… where fate stops, nobody knows.
[delighted] A treat! The spirits are generous tonight. Go, claim your sweet reward.
Hmm… the candles burn bright for you. A treat is yours.
[gasps] The golden hourglass! In a hundred years, I have seen this only thrice. The Grand Prize is yours!
[slowly] Let me look into the glass…
[whispers] The mist is clearing… I see…
The black cat crossed your path… and changed its mind. Spin again!
[softly] The golden hourglass has already been claimed tonight… but the spirits will not send you away empty-handed. Take a treat!

fortunes.text: A door you thought was locked will creak open before the next full moon.
Someone is thinking of you right now… and smiling. Or plotting. The mist is unclear.
An email you have been dreading will turn out to be good news.
Beware of the third cookie. The first two are safe.
A black cat will cross your path, and it will bring luck, not trouble.
The stars say yes. The moon says maybe. The bats refuse to comment.
An old friend will send a message, and it will make your whole week.
Your courage is bigger than your shadow, even at sunset.
A small risk you take this month will grow into something wonderful.
The spirits see an adventure in your future. Pack snacks.
Someone at this party will remember your kindness for years.
You will laugh so hard this week that a ghost somewhere will hear it.
A deadline will move in your favour. Do not ask how. Just say thank you.
A wish you made long ago is still on its way. Do not cancel it.
You will be brave at exactly the right moment.
The candle flickers your name. Something sweet is coming.
The coffee machine will work on the first try when you need it most.
The answer you are looking for is in the reading you skipped. The spirits are sorry.
A secret will be told to you. Keep it. The spirits are watching.
Your future is bright… almost too bright for a creature of the night like me.

audio.prompt: Instrumental, mysterious Victorian music box and low cello, slow waltz, candlelit fortune teller's parlour, eerie but playful, seamless loop
Soft night wind through a ruined chapel, distant owl, seamless loop
Heavy wooden wheel creaks and starts turning
Single short wooden peg click against a leather flap, dry, no reverb
Rising ghostly choir drone building tension
Wheel thuds to a stop, candle flames whoosh up
Magical chime with tiny sparkles and a soft spooky giggle
Grand pipe organ sting, bells and shimmering gold sparkles
Old parchment scroll unrolling with a soft whoosh
